basics.name: Sunny Raghvendra Singh
basics.label: Freelance Full-Stack Web Developer | Applied AI & LLM Evaluation
basics.summary: I have 16 years of experience building websites for clients. I work across full-stack development, technical SEO and infrastructure reliability. I build crawlers and data pipelines for research, analyse threat activity from honeypot logs, and evaluate how accurately language models extract information from text.

objective: Open to remote contracts in full-stack web development, technical SEO, data engineering and applied AI. I welcome research collaborations on LLM evaluation and threat analysis.

work.name: Self-employed
work.summary: Build and maintain websites and web applications, from the user interface through deployment and monitoring.
highlights: Develop with Next.js and Astro. Implement structured data, sitemaps, redirects and indexing rules, and verify what search crawlers receive.
Use Cloudflare edge caching and build monitoring tools for servers and web applications. Analyse HTTP honeypot requests and recorded SSH sessions to study attacker behaviour.

projects.name: Open-source LLM evaluation tools
projects.description: Investigated scoring errors in open-source evaluation libraries and submitted fixes with regression tests.
highlights: In ControlArena, an invalid score of 11/10 could be recorded as a perfect 10. In DeepEval, a strict binary judge could accept scores outside the allowed range.

projects.name: Server and application monitoring
projects.description: Built a Go monitoring agent that buffers observations when the network drops and replays them after reconnection.
highlights: In a local ten-minute outage test across five targets, the recovered data covered every five-minute reporting interval.

projects.name: First Light Dog
projects.description: Built a free resource for owners of diabetic dogs in India after my Labrador, Cooper, was diagnosed. Owners’ accounts inspired my study of whether an LLM could identify who reported a care practice.
highlights: People for Animals India published my guides to canine diabetes and glucose meters for dogs.

publications.name: Speaker-level care-practice attribution in canine-diabetes discussions: a preregistered single-annotator evaluation of a language model
publications.summary: I annotated 100 discussion openings and locked the labels before running the model. In the 98 openings with usable model responses, it recovered 18 of the 106 care-practice reports I had identified.

publications.name: Owner guides on canine diabetes and glucose meters
publications.summary: Two owner guides for readers in India.
